narrative: The churn model finds GBP 18.6M of recurring revenue at risk (3.3% of the GBP 572M recurring base). Seven channel partners hold 41% (GBP 7.6M). Drivers: legacy lines with no migration order before the switch-off, SIP customers evaluating Teams Operator Connect, and billing disputes. Upsell potential on the same accounts is GBP 11.2M.

signals.title: £18.6M recurring revenue at risk — 7 partners hold 41%
signals.source: Gamma churn model on Snowflake (SDP model)
signals.excerpt: Churn classifier scored every account from billing-run, order and support signals; drivers are legacy lines with no migration order, Operator Connect evaluation and billing disputes.

signals.title: UK PSTN switch-off — January 2027
signals.excerpt: Exchanges moving to stop-sell accelerate legacy ISDN/PSTN ceases; customers must migrate to IP voice (PhoneLine+, Horizon, SIP) or leave.
